subject: staticub
authorization: Standing owner direction 1 (Meshy, no generation cap); CLAUDE.md art rule (agent-drafted reference)
disposition: New Meshy multi-image-to-3D mesh rigged on the 15-bone quadruped skeleton beside the installed model; flag-off candidate; installed creature_staticub_lod0.glb, species.json and the native candidate recipe are unchanged.

concept_task.prompt: Staticub, a stylised storm bear cub creature for a 3D action RPG, same character as the reference images. Cub proportions: a big round head about 30% larger than the reference, short rounded muzzle with a dark brown-black nose, large round blue eyes with a clear white catchlight, big round ears, a compact chunky body and short thick chunky legs with soft rounded paws and short claws. Warm chocolate-brown and tan-brown fur (neutral warm brown like milk chocolate, cool shadows), lighter tan muzzle. Thin branching blue-violet glowing lightning veins running across the shoulders, back and flanks, drawn as clean crisp graphic shapes as part of the fur. Matte stylised clumped fur in a Palworld / Animal Crossing-style 3D game look, soft and readable, not photoreal, not shaggy. Neutral four-legged standing stance, all four legs clearly separated from each other and from the belly with visible gaps between them, head facing forward, full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting. No red, no pink, no mauve, no maroon, no reddish tint in the fur. No accessories, no armor, single creature only. Balance between the first (installed character) and last two references: keep the clumped sculpted fur texture covering the WHOLE body including the head, cheeks and ears (no smooth vinyl-toy surfaces), a natural bear-cub head shape enlarged only about 30% (not chibi, head clearly smaller than the body), slightly longer short muzzle, large blue eyes with a white catchlight. Fur an even warm medium brown, hazelnut / milk chocolate, uniform across head and body, cream-tan muzzle. Lightning veins electric blue-violet, thin crisp branching lines over shoulders, back and flanks. Short sturdy legs, all four legs clearly apart with daylight between front and hind legs in the side view.
reference_images: input_refs/warm_native.png (native-standing-v1 hue-shifted +13 deg on warm reds to steer off red)

generation_verdict: Best candidate: identity kept, clumped matte fur head and body, uniform warm hazelnut brown (hue 21 deg, 2.3% near-red texels, no pink/mauve), head ~40% larger, short chunky legs separated from each other and from belly up to ~25% height, crisp branching blue-violet veins.

scripts: source/prepare_regen_candidate.py (copy of stormursa/source/v3/prepare_v3_candidate.py: weld, leg-line align to rig -Y, decimate to 28000 tris keeping UVs, measured 15-bone quadruped skeleton, anatomical regions with local surface diffusion, bear knees at 0.48 spine height, fitted to 3.25 m)
source/author_native_clips.py (copy of stormursa v3: world-axis quaternion keys, 11 roles, grounded per key)
source/check_regen_deformation.py (copy of stormursa v3: 30-degree bone rotation follow ratio)

alignment.note: nose on rig forward (-Y), leg line within 0.06 deg of the forward axis

rig.ears: no ear bones (ears ride the head region)

deformation_note: 30-degree rotation of each leg upper bone, neck and head: strongly weighted distal vertices follow at 0.99-1.00 of rigid motion (all moved over 5 cm). Local Blender pose_test.py renders (stride/look/crouch, not committed) show legs, neck and head bending; the extreme front stride stretches the front paw fur. Not a judge verdict.

scale.note: Fitted to the installed Staticub 3.25 m standing height (x1.8775 from the native 1.731 m; length 1.898 x 1.8775 = 3.563 m matches the measured 3.562 m). Never smaller than the installed model; taller than the 1.80 m trainer.

palette.note: Warm hazelnut brown fur (hue 21) is the species identity; the broad red/rust policy band (h<24) necessarily includes brown fur (0.81 here, 0.86 installed). Strictly red/pink texels fell from 54% on the installed model to 3.3% (nose/mouth/shadow areas). No pink, mauve or oxblood fur.
